m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>An Introduction to the Forge of Legends. Your guide to the Arcanum's supermundane smelter. By Ignus Ferric. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>While it's unknown who built the Forge of Legends, it's construction shows techniques from multiple Worlds. Even different dimensions! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>It's believed this uncommon design is what imbues the Forge with the unique ability to produce items of Legendary quality. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>That unrivaled composition also creates an operational paradox, in that it can only be operated by a Legendary Crafter. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>However, the only known way a Crafter can attain Legendary Crafting level is to use the Forge of Legends. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Due to this conundrum, the Forge of Legends sat dormant for centuries. Then, after many years of frustrating study I had a revelation. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Crafters where I come from have a saying: 'No matter the problem, one must always forge ahead.' </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Therefore, to attain the skill required to use the Forge of Legends, one simply needs to use the Forge of Legends! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>That said, to Craft anything of substance a Legendary Crafting Recipe is also required. So I hammered out a few of those too! </ITALICS>
Back so soon? Did you do your homework on the Forge of Legends? Smashing! Then you're ready to 'forge ahead' and become a Legendary Crafter!
Here, this Teleportation Tapestry Recipe will serve as a good start with the Forge of Legends. Then it'll help you return!
Once you've mastered that, I'll have more Legendary Crafting Recipes I can sell you. Well, go on then. Get to Smelting Room and get Crafting!
While perusing your Initiate's Dossier, I noticed that you're a Promethean Crafter. We don't get many of those around here.
As a lifelong Crafting enthusiast myself, I reckoned I should introduce you to a Crafting table like none other: the Forge of Legends!
An intergalactic-class Crafter like you could make some incredible things with it. Legendary things even!
I could go on for volumes about the Forge. In fact, I did! So rather than listen to me blather on, you can read my work on your own time.
Start with the first chapter of my book, 'An Introduction to Forge of Legends' over in the Repository. Then come back, and we can discuss it!
